metadata.title: Phishing in the name of the Federal Tax Administration (FTA)
metadata.teaserTitle: Phishing in the name of the Federal Tax Administration (FTA)
metadata.teaserText: The NCSC is currently receiving a large number of reports of phishing attempts carried out in the name of the Federal Tax Administration (FTA). These involve an alleged tax refund or a supposedly new system or system changeover. As part of this, a great deal of personal information is requested, such as your date of birth, telephone number and bank account details.
